AI Overview
Tunnel Rush is a fast-paced, 3D first-person skill and reaction game developed by Deer Cat Games. 
How to Play
Objective: Guide a ball or craft through a colorful, neon-lit, swirling 3D tunnel. Dodge rotating blocks, spinning barriers, and sudden gaps. Crashing once means restarting the level.
PC Controls: Use the Left Arrow or A key to move left, and the Right Arrow or D key to move right. Press the Spacebar to pause or restart.
Mobile Controls: Swipe or tap the left and right sides of the screen to steer.
Game Modes: Features single-player endless/level modes, a 2-player split-screen mode on the same device, and varying difficulty speeds (Easy, Medium, Hard). 
Where to Play
You can play the game directly in your web browser on platforms like Poki.
